notes.title: Update 003 - Post Halloween Hotfix
notes.notes:
Hello Smashpunks!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41216945/ff66fd51ac325e4f924dc4eadf97af7a058d214b.png

Another smaller update for Smashpunks has just gone live! This one contains the following:

Fix for a serious performance issue that cropped up after switching to Unreal Engine 4.27. Those of you who reported framerate issues should be able to play as normal now!

New logo has been added to the game, let us know what you think!

Things have returned to normal for the world of Coil, the maps feel a lot less spooky now!

Be sure to join us every Wednesday at 19:30 GMT for the Prospect Playtest and catch us on the Prospect Stream on Twitch! 

Also, feel free to drop by the Prospect Discord to discuss all things Smaspunks!

notes.title: Smashpunks Playtest Update 003 - The Halloween Update 🎃
notes.notes:
It's that spooky time of year and even the Smashpunks on the world of Coil are feeling it... 

This update brings with it a whole bunch of bug fixes and refinements across the board, from the bots, the HUD through to the gamemode. We've also started to stream the game so be sure to drop by the Prospect Twitch channel when we're live! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41216945/78091fba0e84be6d3bbf39cc01109d310fba1882.jpg

In the meantime be sure to jump into the game and try to survive the spooky changes this update brings...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41216945/d7de13cd384b6b0e280571778d825a45bbfae7c9.jpg

Remember to join us every Wednesday at 19:30 GMT for our Weekly play sessions to join the chaos! If you've not got one already, grab a free copy of the Smashpunks Playtest build here!

What's in Update 003...
Pulse's (personal) healing time has been increased to three seconds. This is slightly slower than before as a skilled Pulse player could recover all of their health very quickly mid fight. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41216945/48284cbbdc5a432e8e9a0907ba1dbc69290ede94.gif

Wartoise's puncher collision should feel a lot better. In the past Wartoise wasn't fighting as well as it could due to hit detection and collision issues. Now Wartoise feels a lot more consistent and is ready to get up close and start punching!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41216945/6f0503cb75d9663a6b12cf1a0d914e11aab5dff2.jpg

Smashpunks has been updated to Unreal Engine 4.27. This one's a behind the scenes update but we hope you should experience some improvements to the game performance that this Unreal Engine Update brings.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41216945/8d76d38de3824d9b0c3ba0ff711044e4941bf5be.jpg

Flag carriers no longer get a battery reward when scoring. This was a remnant of the old design where the flag carriers would have their battery drain when holding the flag. This was a little harsh so we moved to the system we have now, and this feature remained. As the player no longer loses battery when carrying the flag, this feature has been removed.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41216945/bcb03f913b154021e0e9ae629adc2574179883d6.jpg

The Ultimate meter now shows how much time you have left before it runs out. This should allow for more precise and tactical Ultimate usage, and also help everyone see how long their Ultimate has left before draining.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41216945/811f7f234215ec0804be84427dcc48a13ded3c06.gif

In addition to the above there's been some strange goings on at Double Top and Carrier, but who knows what it could be... something spooky probably!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41216945/9357e720f4567b057c59da07859a7f9ad8a90dd5.png

Bug Fixes

 Fixed a problem with the camera continuing to shake even after destruction.
 Damage boost overlay should now always clear after destruction.
 Friendly bubble shield doesn’t block allies anymore after they respawn.
 Shellguard only damages enemies.
 UI being too high on the screen has been fixed.
 Fixed the alignment of Pulse’s battery meter and other HUD alignment issues.

Want to report a bug? Non-crash bugs go here and crash bugs go here. Thanks!


So with all that said, be sure to jump into the game over the next week or so and enjoy the Halloween update! Remember, if you have any feedback or suggestions, let us know on Prospect's Discord!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41216945/03661c016774e62d8e3d3032a9e1e5acb1598144.png

That's all for this update, thanks to our Patrons and Players for supporting us!
Play Smashpunks for free: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1016830/Smashpunks/

Join the Smashpunks community: https://discord.gg/prospect

notes.title: Smashpunks Playtest Update 002 - The Path is Clear
notes.notes:
This week we bring you a Smashpunks update with new flag features, super screen effects and a bunch of bug fixes. You can check out all of these additions in our free Smashpunks Playtest on Steam right now! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41216945/c7d0642688aea8e765517c304c15e8cde7301630.jpg

Not only are we continuing to run our Smashpunks Game Night every Wednesday at 19:30 GMT,  we're also going to be regularly streaming matches, development and anything else we think might entertain you! Our Prospect Twitch channel is young but ambitious, give it a follow so you don't miss us! 


Let's take a look at what's in update 002...


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41216945/35246ed8a62b228c9d5a5926e2b9e766c9fbb033.jpg

Forgetful Flag Carriers rejoice! We've added a dynamic path that will shoot out of your fighter and direct you to the right goal, handy right? Sure Google Maps popularized this tool, but Prospect has perfected it.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41216945/82e7cd8437b0a35b066e2f181ceed5d887f50e5d.png

Screen effects to indicate damage, healing and more have been implemented for your viewing pleasure. While some games love to have bars, graphs and a million numbers, we're opting for a more simple approach. Screen Red? You dead. Screen Green? I don't have a good rhyme but basically it means you're repairing. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41216945/5ff0cbcee02a4dd0fd00999073f9cb44124d93e7.png

Fighters no longer use magic to move! We've added Thruster Tech™ to each fighters underside to visually represent hopping and air control. We also want to add nice little contour trails to really highlight aerial movement... but that comes later! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41216945/759612cf9d721500e85543809dedad59adf90c9c.jpg


Feel the Heal! Pulses Healing Tower ULT has gone through a visual improvement and one day, we'll even have animations for its little face and arms. Again, that comes later! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41216945/75e204018731a810ed416a4a270cfb647a527d21.jpg

Punchers are now 100% more punchy. Smashpunks is all about kinetic combat, or to put it simply: things should move when fighting! So we've given the Wartoise puncher a nice little impulse on impact to help keep combat moving. Use it to bat back enemies or even nudge your allies in the right direction... 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41216945/0503b29840171ff1a140f16f30d818c1146f73cb.png
Key Art attack! You may have noticed at the top of the post a shiny new piece of key art and overhauled logo, cool right?! Branding is everything and our goal is to achieve a "look" that can cut through the contemporary noise of drab rehashes and uninspired sequels. 

Are we doing a good job of that? Absolutely. But if you have any feedback or suggestions, let us know below or on Prospect's Discord! 

Bug fixes & Changes: 

 Fixed the issue with the Repair not being cancelled on destruction
 The health vignette should now be less obtrusive
 Frequency of collision sound effects has been reduced
 Host should no longer be able to hear all players' collisions
 Wartoise can not be hit through the Shellguard Ultimate
 Propellers on Carrier no longer interact with the Shellguard
 There is a fix for the flag moving between locations when it should be static
 Fix for the repair wrench visuals has been implemented
 Repair prompt should no longer appear on respawn
 Emote system should show the numbers/D-Pad controls when it’s selected
 Pause menu has been moved to Esc when using Keyboard and Mouse
 Pause Menu feedback box doesn’t close when typing words that contain the letter P.
 Wartoise Special, the Bubble Shield now lasts must longer when deployed 


Want to report a bug? Non-crash bugs go here and crash bugs go here. Thanks!


Smashpunks Community
As we grow, so does the community! We're going to be ramping up our efforts to produce streams, videos and maybe even memes... fortunately our fans are already doing some of the heavy lifting for us! 

Cutlass206 is streaming Smashpunks and sharing the madness with the world! This Monster play session went on for hours and even featured Andrew dropping in to show everyone the ropes (aka noobstomp). 

You can follow Cutlass206 on Twitch for more Smashpunks streams! 

Fan Trailers? Already?! Patreon Supporter Biscuits has a very awesome son who has channeled Kojima Energy into this excellent Smashpunks fan trailer. We'll need a director for the inevitable Smashpunks movie, have we already found our match?

That's all for this update, thanks to our Patrons and Players for supporting us!
Play Smashpunks for free: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1016830/Smashpunks/

Join the Smashpunks community: https://discord.com/invite/ejSUJEJA5P

notes.title: Steam Playtest Update One
notes.notes:
Hello Smashpunks! 

We hope you're enjoying the Free Playtest on Steam and if you didn't know about it... now you do!  We've just entered the third week of the Steam Playtest and we have an awesome new build with content, fixes and more.
 
Just head over to the Smashpunks Steam page and find this button ⬇️⬇️⬇️.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41216945/a66a710b4125ece37fb80861ece253853fc62af2.png

Smash it as hard as you can to instantly gain access to Smashpunks and while you're at it, you can always hit wishlist too 😉. 

Now you've got Smashpunks, who can you play with? Well every Wednesday at 19:30GMT we host a Game Night on the Prospect Discord, come join us for laughter, tears and intense battles! 

Let's take a look at what's in the latest build... 
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41216945/5da76ee4a0cf93298910f7ca290dca135717d7c1.png
Double Top’s surrounding environment has gone through a major overhaul, with a much better layout to the city, flying ships galore and even animated  billboards. We want the backdrop of each arena to be exciting and packed with details about the world of Coil and why the Smashpunks fight.
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41216945/a6da4a7a7062f9fd46c769b07845af2d2c82e942.jpg
Flag carriers are faster now. While carrying the FlagBot should limit the player's speed, being a carrier should feel like a challenge and not a punishment. We heard your feedback loud and clear and we'll continue to make tweaks to make sure every aspect of Smashpunks is exciting! 
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41216945/fff14ff24693b785d93fcb36638cbea71907a447.png
Wartoise’s size has been increased in order to make it feel more imposing, tougher and to stop other bots from driving over it. It's now even better at blocking those enemy flag carriers and fulfilling it's role as a defense fighter. 
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41216945/9fd8f29113029d81acb29067e15bb1fc94049053.png
Punchers have been significantly improved to help them feel more consistent and fun. This will affect Pulse, Wartoise and any other punchy fighters we add in the future.  There's also been a fighter-wide stat tweak to improve balance during fights, but if you think something doesn't feel right, tell us!
 
This updates bug fixes: 
    
 Fixed the reported issue of the flag bouncing back and forth after scoring
 Fixed an issue where certain abilities didn’t cancel a manual repair
 Particles now spawn in Low and Medium settings
 Player’s ‘Ultimate’ ability is now reset between rounds
 The repair prompt no longer appears when a player respawns
 HUD elements should no longer show if the HUD has not yet started
 The D-Pad/Number icons should now be visible in-game
 Fixed an issue where Vote to Concede wasn't available after switching maps
 Fixed other networking/server issues


Want to report a bug? Non-crash bugs go here and crash bugs go here. Thanks! 
 
Captured a clutch moment, crazy carnage or an inspiring show of skill? 
Share it with us on the #clips channel, we'll then feature the best moments and ensure your awesome antics are forever immortalized in Smashpunks history! 

That's all for this update!


Smashpunks Free Playtest: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1016830/Smashpunks/ 
Prospect Discord: https://discord.gg/TwjATakx
